facts.fact: The Konza Technopolis Development Authority, a state agency, says it is operationalising a National Data Center offering a wide array of digital services to both government and private enterprises, including cloud, hosting and colocation, in a call for partners opened 8 July 2025.
The Konza Technopolis Development Authority describes the Konza National Data Center it is operationalising as Tier III certified, in a call for partners opened 8 July 2025.

The Konza Technopolis Development Authority, a state agency under the Ministry of Information, Communications and the Digital Economy, says it is operationalising a National Data Center offering services to government and private enterprises, in a call for partners opened 8 July 2025.
The Konza Data Center is run by the Konza Technopolis Development Authority, a Kenyan state agency, per its own call for partners of 8 July 2025.
The Authority describes the Konza National Data Center as Tier III certified, in its call for partners opened 8 July 2025.

KEN.note: Konza seeks investors for a secondary data centre and vendors for backup services; no backup site in service for a public body is stated.
Document is a vendor call; no startup law, label or fund stated.
Konza is called a technopolis seeking startups; no hub programme or tenants in service stated.
